description: Cloudflare's edge in front of the public sites: requests, answers, cache, countries and the WAF per zone, and the tunnels' connectors.
title: Cloudflare

panels.description: Cloudflare's GraphQL API through the data source cloudflare (README, Cloudflare), for every zone. The Adaptive datasets are sampled, and hold 31 days: a range past 30 days fails. Requests: every zone's, per hour over the range. Edge 5xx: answers of 500 or more at the edge, the origin's and Cloudflare's own (52x, 530 when a tunnel has no connector). Cache hit: hit, stale, updating and revalidated, over every request. Threats blocked: WAF events that blocked the request or challenged it. Connectors up: cloudflared connectors whose target answers and that hold at least one connection to the edge, out of the two per tunnel. Every Cloudflare query runs here, three per refresh, and the other blocks read these frames: the API allows 300 per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Requests per hour by zone
panels.description: Requests per hour at the edge, one line per zone; a zone without requests in the range is left out.

panels.title: Answers per hour by class
panels.description: Answers per hour at the edge by status class, every zone together. Other: no status, or 1xx.

panels.title: Countries
panels.description: The ten countries with the most requests over the range, by zone; the share is of every country's requests. Tor shows as Tor. A ranked bar, not a map: a handful of countries carries the traffic.

panels.title: WAF events by rule
panels.description: Firewall events over the range by rule (its source, and the first characters of its ID), coloured by what the rule did. Blocked: block, drop, connection close. Challenged: a challenge served. Passed: a challenge solved or bypassed.

panels.title: HA connections
panels.description: Connections each connector holds to Cloudflare's edge (cloudflared_tunnel_ha_connections, job cloudflared). Four is whole; a gap is a target that did not answer.

panels.title: Requests per hour
panels.description: Requests each connector carried from the edge, per hour (cloudflared_tunnel_total_requests).

panels.title: Errors per hour
panels.description: Requests each connector failed to proxy to the origin, per hour (cloudflared_tunnel_request_errors).
